NAME:
   rancher inspect cluster - Inspect a cluster: status, agent connectivity, machine pools, members, machines, and registration

USAGE:
   rancher inspect cluster [flags] <name>

FLAGS:
   --address address                                      with --registration: the node address the node command registers (Node Public IP in the Rancher UI), or several separated by ","
   --controlplane                                         with --registration: add the control plane role to the node command (no role flag adds all three)
   --etcd                                                 with --registration: add the etcd role to the node command (no role flag adds all three)
   --help, -h                                             show help
   --internal-address address                             with --registration: the node internal address the node command registers (Node Private IP in the Rancher UI), or several separated by ","
   --label key=value [ --label key=value ]                with --registration: a node label key=value for the node command (repeatable)
   --node-name name                                       with --registration: the node name the node command registers (a lowercase DNS subdomain)
   --registration                                         show the registration commands (they contain the cluster registration token and are left out by default); also available with: `rancher get clusterregistrationtoken default-token --namespace <cluster-id>`
   --taint key=value:effect [ --taint key=value:effect ]  with --registration: a node taint key=value:effect for the node command, effect NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule or NoExecute (repeatable)
   --windows                                              with --registration: compose the Windows node commands instead of the Linux ones, where the Rancher UI shows them
   --worker                                               with --registration: add the worker role to the node command (no role flag adds all three)

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
